verdict.rationale: Viam has a dedicated 'use Viam from an agent' guide saying an agent with a shell or SDK can operate a machine the same way a person can. The guide covers discovering resources and their status, and planning collision-checked motion through the motion service. Scoping is documented via per-resource, per-method `user_permissions` in machine config and the fleet API's permission and authorization management, while the machine API and CLI expose remote control of every method. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of creating scoped API keys or credentials for an agent, and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent driving a real robot end-to-end.
